card.name: Smoking in risk factor lists
card.fires_on: The word for smoking or tobacco (smoke, smoking, tobacco) when it appears in a list of risk factors or history, usually after hypertension or diabetes. Also the word 'of' in 'history of' just before heavy smoking.
